title: Thread splitter
summary: Split a launch post into posts that fit a short limit, without cutting a word.
spec:
Create sparefold/gtm/thread.py with split_thread(text, limit=280) -> list[str].

Contract, checked by projects/gtm/checks/check_gtm_002.py:
- Normalize whitespace to single spaces. Empty or whitespace-only text raises ValueError.
- Each returned post is "i/n " plus words, and len(post) <= limit.
- Never split a word. If one word cannot fit in a post after its prefix, raise ValueError.
- i and n are 1-indexed and n is the final number of posts. Choosing the split must account for the width of that final prefix.
- Dropping each "i/n " prefix and joining the remainders with single spaces returns the normalized text.
- Do not edit the checker. Do not edit sparefold/gtm/__init__.py.
